question: In Slack: In #incidents, add a rocket reaction to the payment gateway outage message that Diego Alvarez reacted to with fire. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
No such message, so I didn't react to anything. Here's what I found in #incidents:

There's exactly one payment gateway outage message — *"Payment gateway outage — CPU spike traced to the retry loop."* (Omar Haddad) — and its reactions are:
- 🔥 fire — Aisha Khan
- 👍 thumbsup — Diego Alvarez

Diego reacted to it with **thumbsup**, not fire, and he has no fire reactions on any other message there. If you still want the 🚀 on that outage message anyway, say the word and I'll add it.
